headline: Two Microsoft fetch fixes: Sentinel's fetch limit and Graph Security's first-fetch timestamp
summary_md:
- A two-pack day for two upstream commits (+245/-159). No pack was added or removed.
- Both fixes land on incident fetching in a Microsoft integration, so both bear on how much gets ingested rather than on what the integration can do.
- **AzureSentinel** (+197/-151) carries the fetch-limit fix and is near line-for-line — insertions and deletions largely cancel.
- **MicrosoftGraphSecurity** (+48/-8) corrects fetch-incidents filtering on the first fetch timestamp.

highlights.title: Microsoft Sentinel's fetch limit is fixed
highlights.detail: #45673 is the day's larger change at +197/-151; the balance of insertions against deletions is that of a rewritten block rather than added capability.

highlights.title: Graph Security fetch-incidents filtering on the first fetch timestamp is corrected
highlights.detail: #45675 moves MicrosoftGraphSecurity +48/-8, an addition-weighted change consistent with new filtering logic rather than a replacement.

items.Packs/AzureSentinel: +197/-151. Fixes the Microsoft Sentinel fetch limit (#45673), and the day's larger of two changes.
items.Packs/MicrosoftGraphSecurity: +48/-8. Fixes fetch-incidents filtering on the first fetch timestamp (#45675).
